description.value:
Your name carries stolen knowledge. (Heritage roll 8)

Modifier: -2 Action Points.

Other effects (apply manually): Learn a Rank 3 technique (d10 type roll: 1-2 Ninjutsu, 3 Chakra Control, 4-6 Taijutsu, 7 Fuinjutsu, 8 Genjutsu, 9 Hijutsu, 10 Kinjutsu); pick one technique of that type.
